$comment: HAND-AUTHORED from v0211-rowcolumn-prose-derived.xml (Rule 10, D-030). MapType=Row/Column: each BinCode is a RUN starting at a logical (X, Y) and running as far as its token count. The five runs here are deliberately uneven - a full row, two partial runs sharing row 1, a run starting mid-row, and another full row - so a reader that treated them as whole rows would place three of the five wrongly. This is the fixture that caught D-028: the serializer emitted payload row indices where the document wants LOGICAL coordinates, and the map came back vertically flipped.
